projects.name: Deep Packet Inspection and Network Traffic Analyzer
projects.description: A Python-based Deep Packet Inspection and network traffic analysis system for offline PCAP files. It parses Ethernet, VLAN, IPv4, TCP, and UDP traffic; extracts domains from TLS SNI, HTTP Host headers, and DNS queries; tracks bidirectional flows; classifies applications; filters traffic; and generates PCAP and JSON reports.
highlights: Reimplemented and enhanced a C++ Deep Packet Inspection engine in Python.
Implemented bidirectional flow tracking, application classification, and IP-, application-, and domain-based traffic filtering.
Generated filtered PCAP files and structured JSON reports with robust error handling and automated tests.
Successfully analyzed a 77-packet test capture with zero parsing errors.

projects.name: Candidate AI Representative
projects.description: A deployed full-stack, resume-grounded AI assistant that provides streaming answers using an active candidate resume and structured profile data. It supports resume upload and download, text extraction, interview question generation, job-description suitability scoring, why-hire responses, multilingual interaction, voice input and output, conversation history, and PDF chat export.
highlights: Built a full-stack resume-grounded AI assistant with streaming answers.
Implemented PDF resume upload, download, and text extraction.
Added interview questions, job-match scoring from 0 to 100, and a why-hire mode.
Added speech-to-text, text-to-speech, English, Hindi, and Bengali support, conversation history, and PDF chat export.
Deployed the React frontend on Vercel and the FastAPI backend on Render.
